title: Healer (The Dragon #3) for 1e FRPG
description: An optional healer class for 1e FRPG, based on C. Hettlestad's "Healers" (The Dragon #3, October 1976): its levels, titles, hit dice, spells per day and own seven-level spell list, the powers gained at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 20th level, and race limits. Rules restated in plain words. Adds a Healer tab and compendia. Turn it on or off in Manage Modules.
